jobs.name: Weekly Developer News Report
jobs.prompt:
Perform the following task:
1. Visit the following 10 developer news sources to collect the most recent and relevant news:
- Hacker News: https://news.ycombinator.com
- Dev.to: https://dev.to
- Hashnode: https://hashnode.com
- TechCrunch: https://techcrunch.com
- The Verge Tech: https://www.theverge.com/tech
- InfoQ: https://www.infoq.com
- Reddit r/programming: https://www.reddit.com/r/programming/
- GitHub Blog: https://github.blog
- AWS Blog: https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/aws/
- Stack Overflow Blog: https://stackoverflow.blog

2. Deep-dive into the top 10-20 most impactful stories. Actually read the articles to understand the core value and implications.
3. Create a comprehensive summary for each.

4. Prepare the output in TWO formats:
   - A visual text report for WhatsApp with emojis, titles, bullet-point summaries, and URLs.
   - A natural, conversational script intended for Text-to-Speech (TTS) that summarizes the most important highlights of the day in a friendly, engaging way.

5. In the final delivery, use the `text_to_speech` tool to convert the conversational script into an audio file and include the MEDIA tag in the response along with the text report.

Format: 🚀 DAILY DEV BRIEF (Text) followed by 🎙️ AUDIO SUMMARY (Voice Note).
